title: Inbound BDR — AI-Native Qualifier
description:
FlytBase


Every Fortune 500 deal starts with one conversation \- you'll learn to own it. Master the art of qualifying fast, asking the right questions, and deciding what's real \- with real ownership from day one.


Business Development
 Pune, India (Onsite)
 Full\-time
 Freshers
  
### **What We Do**


FlytBase is the global category leader in Physical AI for Large sites. FlytBase’s drone autonomy platform powers mission\-critical operations across 300\+ enterprise sites in 40\+ countries. Our customers include Fortune 500 leaders such as Shell, CSX, UK Police, Airbus, Anglo American, Dole, and Statnett. FlytBase has its presence in 70\+ countries with offices in the US and Pune, India. FlytBase is building the nervous system for large industrial sites. We operate at AI speed \- autonomy and intelligence at our core. Our lean team thrives in a high\-agency, high\-velocity environment where AI is not a side project; it is the operating system for how we think, build, and grow.
### **The Role**


You are the first human touchpoint for every inbound lead that flows into FlytBase. A mining executive downloads our white paper. A facilities manager books a demo. A partner forwards a warm intro. They all land with you first—and it's your job to figure out what happens next. This isn't script\-reading or box\-checking. You'll learn to research accounts, ask sharp questions, and make real judgment calls: Is this a sales\-ready opportunity for our AE team? Does it need more nurturing? Should it be routed to a regional partner? You'll own that decision—with coaching and AI tools to help you get faster and smarter every week. You'll talk to people running energy grids, mining operations, and critical infrastructure. They're exploring autonomous drone systems for the first time. Your job is to understand their world quickly, send the right materials, and qualify intelligently. This is where you learn enterprise sales from the ground up—at a company building Physical AI for mission\-critical operations across 300\+ sites in 40\+ countries.
### **What You'll Own**


• Qualifying every inbound lead within 24 hours—research the account, understand the use case, decide the next step • Running discovery calls to understand prospect needs, technical fit, and buying timeline • Routing sales\-ready opportunities to AEs with a clear handoff brief—context, pain points, urgency • Nurturing early\-stage leads through follow\-ups, content sharing, and staying top\-of\-mind until they're ready • Managing regional partner referrals—deciding when to loop in partners vs. handling direct • Building and maintaining your lead database in HubSpot—every interaction logged, every status updated • Using AI tools to research prospects, draft emails, summarize calls, and move faster than humanly possible • Flagging patterns: What campaigns are generating high\-intent leads? What verticals are heating up? • Collaborating with marketing to improve lead quality and refine messaging based on what you hear daily • Learning fast: You'll shadow AE calls, get coached on objections, and level up your enterprise sales IQ every week
### **Best Suited For**


• Freshers who want to build a career in enterprise B2B sales—not just any sales job • Fast learners who can research an unfamiliar industry (mining, energy, logistics) and sound credible in 48 hours • People who are energized by talking to senior executives and asking smart questions, not intimidated by it • Natural curiosity about technology—you want to understand what autonomous drones actually do and why enterprises buy them • Strong written and verbal communication in English—your emails and call notes represent FlytBase • Comfort with AI tools—you'll use ChatGPT, Perplexity, Apollo, and workflows we've built to 10x your output • Self\-starters who don't wait to be told what to do—if a lead goes cold, you figure out how to re\-engage • Coachability—you take feedback, iterate fast, and don't take rejection personally
### **What Makes You a Flyter**


• Ownership without hand\-holding: You won't have a checklist for every scenario. You'll make calls, own outcomes, and learn from mistakes fast. • Resourcefulness over experience: You'd rather Google, research, and figure it out than wait for someone to explain it to you. • Bias for action: You'd rather send an imperfect email today than a perfect one next week. Speed matters. • Hunger to learn enterprise sales: You see this as the foundation of a sales career, not a stepping stone to escape as fast as possible. • High candor: You give honest feedback on what's working and what's not—no corporate BS, no silent frustration. • Competitive energy: You track your metrics, want to be the best qualifier on the team, and care about winning deals (even if you don't close them yourself).
### **What We Don't Want**


• People who see BDR work as beneath them or a checkbox role to 'get through' before real sales starts • Candidates who expect to be spoon\-fed scripts, templates, and step\-by\-step instructions for every interaction • Anyone who thinks talking to prospects is uncomfortable or draining—this role is 80% communication • Low\-agency thinkers who wait for someone to tell them a lead is dead instead of figuring it out themselves • People who measure effort by hours logged, not outcomes created—busy doesn't mean effective • Candidates allergic to feedback or who take coaching as criticism rather than growth fuel
### **Why FlytBase?**


• H3 Philosophy: We're building a company that's Happy, Healthy, AND High\-Performing. Not as a balance—as a harmony. We move fast without burning out. • Radical Ownership: You won't need permission to experiment, build, or lead. If you see a problem, you own the solution. • Mazaa Aayega: Our internal motto. Yes, the work is intense. But it's also deeply meaningful and genuinely fun. • Systems That Scale: We don't celebrate one\-off heroics. We build compounding systems that create leverage. • In\-Person Energy: We work from our Pune office because proximity accelerates everything—ideas, feedback, trust, and impact, but travel globally for customer meetings, tradeshows, and deployments.
### **The Perks**


• High agency team and sense of purpose • International Travel—we travel to all 6 continents (sorry, no business in Antarctica yet) • Thought leadership \& public speaking opportunities at online \& physical events • No\-cap budget for AI tools, courses, or experiments • Latest tech stack and tools—whatever helps you move faster • Family Day—Once a year, we transform our office to showcase our work to the people who matter most • Top\-tier health coverage for you • Unlimited leave policy \& flexible working hours (no punch\-in/out) • A damn good team to work with
### **Who You'll Work With**


You'll report to the Sales Lead and work closely with AEs who will coach you on enterprise deal cycles. You'll also collaborate daily with the marketing team to improve lead quality and share what's actually happening in prospect conversations.
### **Ready to Fly?**


If you want to learn enterprise sales at a company building the future of autonomous operations—and you're ready to own outcomes from day one—let's talk.

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Centre (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors.
   

  

 The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

Maintain accurate and confidential records in the Human Resources Information System (HRIS). Prepares documents for internal and external stakeholders, such as attorneys and regulatory bodies. EMPLOYEE SPECIFICATIONS

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**Job Title:** 
 HR Manager
 



**Company:** 
 Hakke Industries
 



**Location:** 
 Jigani Industrial Area, Bengaluru
 



**Department:** 
 Human Resources
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary Range:** 
 ₹60,000 – ₹80,000 per month, based on experience and suitability
 



**About the Company** 




 Hakke Industries is a growing manufacturing company engaged in the manufacturing of Street Lighting Poles, Octagonal Poles, Conical Poles, High Masts, Stadium Masts, Flag Masts, Decorative poles, CCTV Poles, and Related Steel Infrastructure Products. The company is also expanding into Pre\-Engineered Buildings and other industrial infrastructure projects.
 



 We are looking for a capable and responsible
 **HR Manager** 
 who can handle the complete HR function for our manufacturing units, sales team, office staff, technical staff, workers, and future expansion requirements.
 



**Position Summary** 




 The HR Manager will be responsible for managing recruitment, HR operations, statutory compliance, employee discipline, attendance, manpower planning, performance coordination, documentation, payroll coordination, and employee engagement. The candidate should be able to work closely with management, department heads, plant operations, sales teams, accounts, and administration to ensure smooth HR functioning across the organisation.
 



 The role requires a practical, disciplined, and execution\-oriented HR professional who understands both factory\-level manpower and office/sales team requirements.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Recruitment and Manpower Planning** 



* Handle end\-to\-end recruitment for factory, office, sales, technical, accounts, purchase, stores, production, quality, dispatch, site, and project\-related positions.
* Understand manpower requirements from management and department heads.
* Prepare and maintain recruitment trackers for all open positions.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, references, consultants, job portals, walk\-ins, and other sources.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial interviews, coordinate technical and management interviews, and follow up until joining.
* Prepare offer letters, appointment letters, joining documents, and employee files.
* Maintain proper candidate database and hiring records.
* Support hiring for sales teams, including field sales, internal sales, PEB sales, project sales, and regional sales positions.



**2\. HR Operations and Documentation** 



* Maintain complete employee records, joining forms, KYC documents, attendance records, leave records, salary details, increment records, and exit documents.
* Prepare HR letters such as appointment letters, confirmation letters, warning letters, relieving letters, experience letters, transfer letters, and other official communications.
* Ensure proper onboarding and induction for new employees.
* Maintain HR MIS reports and submit periodic updates to management.
* Coordinate with all departments for employee\-related documentation and approvals.
* Ensure that HR files and controlled documents are properly maintained physically and digitally.



**3\. Attendance, Leave and Payroll Coordination** 



* Monitor daily attendance of staff, workers, sales team, and other employees.
* Coordinate with department heads for absenteeism, late coming, overtime, leave approval, and shift planning.
* Prepare monthly attendance inputs for payroll processing.
* Coordinate with accounts/payroll team for salary processing, deductions, advances, incentives, reimbursements, and full\-and\-final settlements.
* Ensure salary processing data is accurate and submitted on time.



**4\. Statutory Compliance and Labour Law** 



* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, factory\-related HR requirements, ESI, PF, professional tax, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, leave rules, and other statutory requirements.
* Coordinate with consultants and accounts team for statutory filings and records.
* Maintain statutory registers, employee records, wage records, contractor labour records, and compliance documents.
* Ensure proper documentation for labour contractors, contract workers, and factory manpower.
* Support management during inspections, audits, and compliance reviews.



**5\. Employee Discipline and Industrial Relations** 



* Maintain discipline across factory, office, and sales teams.
* Handle employee grievances, misconduct issues, absenteeism, late coming, poor performance, and workplace discipline matters.
* Issue verbal and written warnings wherever required after management approval.
* Coordinate with department heads to resolve employee issues in a fair and professional manner.
* Ensure company rules, reporting systems, attendance discipline, and workplace conduct are followed strictly.
* Support management in creating a professional and accountable work culture.



**6\. Performance Management and Reporting** 



* Coordinate with department heads for performance reviews, probation confirmation, appraisal inputs, and increment recommendations.
* Track performance of employees during probation and after joining.
* Help management identify underperforming employees and support corrective action plans.
* Prepare HR dashboards, manpower reports, recruitment status reports, attrition reports, attendance reports, and compliance reports.
* Follow up with department heads for timely review of employees and pending HR actions.



**7\. Training and Employee Development** 



* Coordinate induction training for new employees.
* Identify basic training needs in coordination with department heads.
* Arrange training related to safety, discipline, reporting, technical skills, sales coordination, HR policies, and workplace behaviour.
* Maintain training attendance records and training documentation.
* Support development of SOPs, HR policies, and employee handbooks.



**8\. Coordination with Plant, Sales and Management Teams** 



* Work closely with production, quality, stores, dispatch, purchase, accounts, sales, site/project, and administration teams.
* Understand manpower requirements for manufacturing operations, plant expansion, sales growth, and new projects.
* Coordinate with sales teams for recruitment, attendance, reporting, travel, incentive documentation, and employee records.
* Support management in implementing systems, procedures, reporting discipline, and HR controls across the organisation.



**9\. Exit Formalities** 



* Conduct exit formalities for resigned or terminated employees.
* Collect company assets, ID cards, documents, tools, uniforms, and other materials.
* Coordinate full\-and\-final settlement with accounts.
* Conduct exit interviews and maintain exit records.
* Ensure proper handover from employees before relieving.



**Required Candidate Profile** 



* Minimum 8 to 12 years of experience in HR, preferably from manufacturing, engineering, steel fabrication, infrastructure, PEB, industrial products, or similar industries.
* Good knowledge of recruitment, HR operations, labour compliance, attendance, payroll coordination, and employee discipline.
* Experience in handling both staff and worker\-level manpower.
* Ability to coordinate with factory teams, sales teams, department heads, and management.
* Strong communication and follow\-up skills.
* Practical knowledge of labour laws, ESI, PF, minimum wages, statutory registers, and contractor labour compliance.
* Should be systematic in documentation, reporting, and record keeping.
* Should be firm, disciplined, confidential, and professional.
* Must be comfortable working in a growing manufacturing organisation with multiple priorities.



**Qualification** 



* MBA / MSW / MHRM / PG Diploma in HR / Bachelor’s degree with strong HR experience.
* Candidates with manufacturing HR experience will be preferred.



**Key Skills** 




 HR Management, Recruitment, HR Operations, Payroll Coordination, Statutory Compliance, Labour Law, ESI, PF, Attendance Management, Employee Relations, Industrial Relations, Manpower Planning, Factory HR, Sales Team Recruitment, Employee Documentation, HR MIS, Performance Management, Employee Discipline.
 



**Preferred Industry Background** 




 Manufacturing, Engineering, Steel Fabrication, PEB, Infrastructure, Industrial Products, Electrical Poles, Heavy Fabrication, Factory Operations, or similar industries.
 



**What We Are Looking For** 




 We are looking for a responsible HR Manager who can take ownership of the complete HR function and support the company’s growth. The candidate should be capable of handling recruitment, employee discipline, compliance, documentation, attendance, payroll coordination, and HR reporting independently.
 



 The candidate should be practical, mature, process\-oriented, and able to work closely with management for building a strong team and disciplined work culture.
 



**Compensation** 




 Salary will be in the range of
 **₹60,000 to ₹80,000 per month** 
 , depending on experience, capability, and suitability. Candidates with expectations beyond this range may not be considered.

title: Site Reliability Engineer — Multi-Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**About The Role**
 Skit.ai is the pioneer Conversational AI company transforming collections with omnichannel GenAI\-powered assistants. Skit.ai’s Collection Orchestration Platform, the world’s first solution, streamlines collection conversations by syncing channels and accounts. Skit.ai’s Large Collection Model (LCM), a collection LLM, powers the strategy engine to optimize interactions, enhance customer experiences, and boost bottom lines for enterprises. Skit.ai has received several awards and recognitions, including the BIG AI Excellence Award 2024, Stevie Gold Winner 2023 for Most Innovative Company by The International Business Awards, and Disruptive Technology of the Year 2022 by CCW. Skit.ai is headquartered in New York City, NY. Visit https://skit.ai/
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Site Reliability Engineer — Multi\-Cloud Infrastructure
   

  

**Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bangalore
   

  

**Why This Role Exists**
 We run a voice AI platform for regulated enterprises in banking, telecom, and collections, spread across AWS, GCP, and Azure — for resilience, for cost, and because client data\-residency rules leave us no choice. That's a lot of surface area: compute, networking, storage, identity, clusters, pipelines, and supporting services, all needing to stay healthy across three providers.
   

  

 This role owns the day\-to\-day reliability and operations of that estate. It's the generalist counterpart to our real\-time\-platform SRE: where they go deep on the latency\-critical call path, you go broad — keeping the whole infrastructure dependable, well\-automated, and cost\-sane, and sharing the on\-call load. If you like knowing how everything fits together and making the boring parts reliable and self\-serve, this is a good seat.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Multi\-cloud operations. Provision, operate, and keep healthy compute, networking, storage, and identity across AWS, GCP, and Azure — with sensible consistency instead of three snowflakes.
* Infrastructure as code. Manage the estate through Terraform (or equivalent) and version control — reproducible environments, reviewed changes, no undocumented hand\-tweaks.
* CI/CD and delivery. Keep build and deploy pipelines fast and reliable so engineers ship safely and often.
* Clusters and workloads. Run Kubernetes/container platforms and the supporting services (databases, queues, caches, internal tooling) that everything depends on.
* Monitoring and on\-call. Maintain monitoring and alerting for infrastructure health, take a turn in the rotation, and respond to and mitigate incidents with clear communication and blameless follow\-up.
* Cost and hygiene. Keep an eye on cloud spend, rightsizing, and waste; own the unglamorous but essential hygiene — patching, backups, secrets, and access.
* Automation and toil reduction. Replace manual, repetitive operations with automation and self\-service so the team scales without headcount scaling with it.


**What The First Year Looks Like**
* First 90 days. Learn the estate across all three clouds. Take a turn on call. Close the most obvious gaps in monitoring, backups, and access hygiene.
* By 6 months. More of the estate under consistent infrastructure\-as\-code. Reliable, reviewed CI/CD. A clearer, quieter alerting setup and documented runbooks for the common incidents.
* By 12 months. Measurably less manual toil through automation and self\-service. Sensible cost controls in place. Provisioning and environment setup that's repeatable rather than tribal knowledge.


**What We're Looking For**
**Must\-have**
* A few years in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure operations for production systems, including on\-call.
* Hands\-on experience across at least two of AWS, GCP, and Azure (all three is a strong plus).
* Kubernetes and containers in production.
* Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or similar) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Monitoring and alerting practice (e.g. Prometheus/Grafana) and structured incident handling.
* A scripting/programming language for automation (Python, Go, or Bash beyond one\-liners).
* Solid Linux systems and networking fundamentals.


**Nice\-to\-have**
* All three clouds run in production, and comfort designing for consistency across them.
* Cost optimization / FinOps.
* Secrets management, security hardening, and compliance/data\-residency contexts.
* PostgreSQL and other stateful\-service operations at scale.
* Some exposure to real\-time or voice infrastructure — enough to back up the platform SRE on call.


**Our Stack**
*Representative — you'll help shape it.* 
 Multi\-cloud across AWS, GCP, and Azure; Kubernetes/containers; Terraform and GitHub Actions CI/CD; PostgreSQL; Grafana/Tempo for monitoring; Modal for ML deployment; LiveKit/SIP telephony on the platform side.
   

  

**How You'll Know You're Succeeding**
 The infrastructure just works, across all three clouds, and when it doesn't it's caught early and fixed cleanly. Engineers provision what they need without filing tickets. Cloud spend is understood, not surprising. And the on\-call rotation trends calmer because the estate is increasingly automated and self\-healing.
   

  

*We're an equal\-opportunity employer and evaluate every candidate on merit. \[Add benefits, compensation band, and application instructions before posting.]*

title: Analyst, Identity Access Management Administrator
description:
SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve.
   

  

 At SitusAMC, we are looking to match your unique experience with one of our amazing careers, so that we can help you realize your potential and career growth within the Real Estate Industry. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team!
   

  

**Job Functions Supporting CyberArk**
* Identity \& Access Management (IAM)
+ Assist in managing AWS IAM users, groups, roles, and policies.
+ Support role\-based access control (RBAC) implementation and maintenance for AWS services, including EC2, Lambda, and other cloud resources.
+ Provision, modify, and deprovision user access across enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and infrastructure systems.
+ Troubleshoot and resolve access\-related issues, including permission errors, authentication failures, and role assumption problems.
+ Participate in periodic user access reviews, certification campaigns, and entitlement audits.
+ Identify, document, and escalate inappropriate access, policy violations, and segregation of duties concerns.
+ Maintain accurate identity data, including user attributes, roles, group memberships, and entitlements across supported systems.
+ Audit and maintain access controls to ensure compliance with organizational security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.

* Privileged Access Management
+ Assist in the administration and maintenance of CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions.
+ Support onboarding and management of privileged accounts, service accounts, and application accounts within CyberArk.
+ Assist with account discovery, password vaulting, credential rotation, and privileged session management activities.
+ Monitor CyberArk platform health, password management processes, and scheduled jobs to ensure operational effectiveness.
+ Troubleshoot and resolve CyberArk\-related issues, including account onboarding failures, password reconciliation issues, and access request problems.
+ Support privileged access request workflows, approvals, and access certifications in accordance with security policies.
+ Assist in implementing and maintaining least\-privilege and privileged access security controls.
+ Perform periodic reviews of privileged accounts and privileged access assignments to ensure compliance with organizational standards.
+ Generate and maintain CyberArk reports related to privileged account activity, password management, and compliance requirements.
+ Maintain CyberArk operational documentation, procedures, and onboarding standards.
+ Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, security, and application teams to onboard systems and accounts into CyberArk.

* Security \& Compliance
+ Assist in implementing and maintaining security controls related to identity and access management.
+ Support vulnerability remediation efforts by deploying updates, patches, and corrective actions in response to identified security risks.
+ Assist with audit requests and provide supporting documentation related to access management, privileged access management, and asset inventories.
+ Ensure adherence to established security policies, procedures, standards, and best practices.
+ Support compliance initiatives related to access governance, privileged access management, and information security controls.

* Service Management \& Documentation
+ Support ServiceNow workflows related to access requests, incident management, change management, and service fulfillment.
+ Create and maintain documentation for IAM and PAM processes, workflows, system configurations, operational procedures, and incident resolutions.
+ Maintain accurate records of system changes, troubleshooting activities, and access management actions.
+ Develop and update knowledge base articles and standard operating procedures.

* Collaboration \& Communication
+ Collaborate with IT, Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Business teams to implement secure technology solutions.
+ Provide technical guidance and support to team members and end users as needed.
+ Communicate technical information effectively, both verbally and in writing, to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
+ Plan, prioritize, and coordinate assigned tasks to meet operational objectives and project deadlines.


**Qualifications/ Requirements**
* Associate's degree or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Entry level professional with 0\-2 years of industry and/or relevant experience, typically at an Analyst level role or external equivalent.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
* Customer\-service mindset and ability to work collaboratively with stakeholders.
* Timely completion of user provisioning and deprovisioning requests.
* Compliance with access review schedules.
* Accuracy of user access assignments.
* Resolution time for IAM\-related incidents and requests.
* Audit findings related to identity and access controls.


* Specific Experience supporting CyberArk
+ Experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), IT Administration, Help Desk, Systems Administration, Cybersecurity, or a related technical role.
+ Experience supporting user account administration and access management processes preferred.
+ Exposure to cloud environments, particularly Amazon Web Services (AWS), preferred.
+ Exposure to CyberArk or other Privileged Access Management solutions is a plus.
+ Basic knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) concepts and best practices.
+ Familiarity with:
- AWS Identity and Access Management (AWS IAM)
- CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM)
- Role\-Based Access Control (RBAC)
- Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA)
- Single Sign\-On (SSO)
- Microsoft Active Directory
- Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
- Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms
- ServiceNow or similar IT Service Management (ITSM) tools
- Basic understanding of AWS Management Console and AWS CLI.
- Familiarity with CyberArk components such as:
- Password Vault Web Access (PVWA)
- Central Policy Manager (CPM)
- Privileged Session Manager (PSM)

+ Knowledge of Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 environments.
+ Familiarity with IT asset management processes and inventory tracking systems.
+ Basic scripting knowledge using PowerShell, Python, or similar technologies is a plus.
+ Experience with reporting tools, dashboards, and data analysis is beneficial.


**Note: This job description is not intended to be all inclusive or exclusive. At any time, employees may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization and participate in additional trainings. SitusAMC does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms or any third parties. Any unsolicited resume submitted to SitusAMC in any manner will be considered SitusAMC property, and SitusAMC will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.**
**The annual full time base salary range for this role is**
 ₹1\.00 \- ₹1\.00
   

  

 Specific compensation is determined through interviews and a review of relevant education, experience, training, skills, geographic location and alignment with market data. Additionally, certain positions may be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus as determined by bonus program guidelines, position eligibility and SitusAMC Senior Management approval.
   

  

 SitusAMC offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits plan.
   

  

 SitusAMC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

 break web apps. think like an attacker. find the stuff automated tools cry about missing. then explain it clearly enough that anyone gets why it matters.

 hands\-on skill. curiosity that borders on suspicious. the instinct to poke the thing you're told not to poke.

 OWASP Top 10 · auth/authz bypass · business logic flaws · API testing · SSRF · IDOR · SQLi · XSS · file upload bypasses · Burp Suite · recon · reporting · a bit of scripting

 degrees. certs. the "right" background. show us you can break things \- that's the whole interview.

 send your writeups, GitHub, bug bounty finds, or sample reports.
 



 no CV template energy. just proof you're dangerous (ethically).

title: Software Engineer(Data Infrastructure)
description:
**About** 




  





 Upscrape builds the infrastructure layer that companies use to access public web data reliably. Instead of every company building fragile scrapers internally, we provide production\-grade APIs and data systems they can depend on. Our clients include enterprise and mid\-market companies across industries.
 



  





 We work across the full data lifecycle, from extraction and transformation to delivery through production\-grade APIs. The problems we solve are technically deep: handling sites that change frequently, maintaining reliability across millions of data points, and building systems that clients can depend on without thinking about what's running behind them.
 



  





 Web data infrastructure is becoming a core dependency for AI systems, analytics platforms, and automation products. We're building the layer that makes that possible reliably.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 This is a full\-time, hybrid role based in Bangalore.
 



  





 You'll build and maintain core infrastructure at Upscrape. Scraping systems, data pipelines, and production APIs that our clients integrate into their workflows. You'll work directly with the founders, join client calls, and ship production code.
 



  





 This is a hands\-on engineering role with high ownership. You won't just execute on specs someone else wrote. You'll have input into how systems are designed and built, and you'll grow into more responsibility quickly.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  




* Build resilient web data extraction systems. Playwright, Puppeteer, HTTP\-based scrapers, headless browsers, proxy rotation, handling bot protections and rate limits. You'll work against complex targets and systems that remain resilient as websites change.
* Build and ship APIs. Clean, documented, production\-grade APIs that our clients integrate into their products and depend on daily.
* Build and maintain data pipelines. From raw HTML to structured, clean, delivered data. You'll work on pipeline architecture, handle transformations, and build monitoring to catch breakages early.
* AI\-assisted engineering. We use AI tools (Cursor, Claude, Codex) as part of daily engineering workflows to increase speed and iteration velocity.



  





**You'll also get exposure to** 




  




* Client conversations. You'll join calls with enterprise clients alongside the founders, understand their data requirements, and translate them into working systems.
* System design. As you ramp up, you'll have increasing input into how we architect our infrastructure and what we build next.
* Product thinking. Understanding why clients need certain data and how they use it will shape how you build.



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* 1–2 years of engineering experience (or strong equivalent through projects or open\-source work). If you have strong foundations and have built something meaningful on your own, that matters more than years on a resume. That said, this role is not for someone entirely new to writing and shipping code.
* Strong Python skills. This is our primary language. You should be comfortable writing, debugging, and optimizing Python.
* Experience with web scraping or strong interest in it. If you've dealt with Cloudflare, understand and worked with undocumented APIs, or built a scraper that survived a site redesign, we want to talk. If you haven't but you're the kind of person who would enjoy it, that works too.
* Comfortable with infrastructure. Docker, cloud deployments (AWS/GCP), databases (Postgres, Redis), task queues, cron jobs. You don't need to be a DevOps expert, but you should be comfortable working with these.
* You ship. You care about working software in production, not perfect architecture on a whiteboard.



  





**What you get** 




  




* Salary depending on experience and what you bring to the table.
* Hybrid role, based in Bangalore. A mix of in\-office and remote, with flexibility on how you structure your week.
* Direct line to the founders.
* Meaningful work from day one. You'll ship things that clients use, not internal tools nobody looks at.
* Compensation and responsibility will scale with impact as the company grows. We're growing, and the people who help us get there will grow with us.



  





**How to apply** 




  





**Apply to this job or send an email to careers@upscrape.com with:** 



1. A short note on why this interests you
2. Links to anything you've built: Github links, projects, whatever shows how you think
3. Your resume

description:
**Company Description** 
 CUBE Architects \& Interior Design is a Bangalore\-based practice with over two decades of experience offering expertise in architecture, interiors, urban planning, and landscape design, with a strong focus on design excellence and smart, research\-driven solutions. Collaboration with clients is central to CUBE’s approach, using sketches and computer visualizations to balance functionality and aesthetics for each project.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site 3D Visualizer role based in Bangalore Urban. The 3D Visualizer will create high\-quality 3D models, renderings, and visualizations for architectural and interior design projects, supporting concept development and client presentations. * Candidates should possess strong visualization skills, including 3D modeling and rendering for architectural and interior design projects.
* Candidates should possess drawing skills, including the ability to interpret architectural drawings and produce basic sketches to support design development.
* Candidates should possess lighting skills, with the ability to simulate realistic daylight, artificial lighting, and material responses in 3D environments.
* Proficiency in industry\-standard 3D and visualization software (e.g., SketchUp, 3ds Max, V\-Ray, D5 Render, Lumion, \& Photoshop) and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Strong attention to detail, time management skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a studio environment.
* Experience in architectural or interior design visualization and a portfolio demonstrating relevant project work.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
Associate Product Manager
 





 Experience: 1\+ years
 





 Location: Gurugram
 





 Department: Product
 





 Company Type: B2B SaaS (Product\-led, global markets)
 




  





 About Contify
 


 Contify is an AI\-powered market and competitive intelligence (M\&CI) platform that delivers decision\-ready insights to leading organizations about their markets, competitors, and key accounts. By monitoring over one million sources, it filters out noise and provides precise intelligence that helps teams make faster, more confident decisions. Teams in strategy, product, marketing, and sales use Contify to observe competitors, track key accounts, detect market shifts in near real time, and turn scattered information into organized, actionable intelligence.
 




  






 Recognized as a Visionary in the first\-ever 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Competitive and Market Intelligence Platforms and a recipient of Frost \& Sullivan's Product Innovation Award, Contify is trusted by enterprises across consulting, technology, financial services, manufacturing, and life sciences sectors. With a team of over 350 professionals, we combine the agility of a high\-growth tech company with the stability of a mature organization. 
 




  





 About the Role
 


 As an Associate Product Manager (APM), you will operate at the intersection of customers, engineering, and business stakeholders—translating complex, real\-world user problems into clear, structured product requirements that development teams can implement. You report directly to the Director of Product and will collaborate closely with engineering, client\-facing teams, and internal stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document requirements. Your main goal is clarity: producing well\-structured PRDs, user stories, and documentation that eliminate ambiguity. This role is ideal for someone who thinks rigorously, writes precisely, and thrives in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments.
 




  





 Key Responsibilities
 

**Requirements \& Documentation** 



* Translate user problems, pains, and requirements into well\-structured product requirement documents (PRDs) that guide engineering development.
* Write clear, structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and product documentation for both internal and external audiences.
* Gather input from multiple stakeholders — customers, internal teams, and market signals — into actionable documentation that supports product development and decision\-making.
* Create and maintain product documentation to keep it current as features and workflows change.



  





**Stakeholder Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Team Managers, Engineering, and client\-facing teams to gather, analyze, and document product requirements.
* Facilitate requirement discussions and workshops to identify the right questions and bring clarity to ambiguous problem statements.
* Act as a coordination layer between product, engineering, and business teams—ensuring everyone shares a common understanding.



  





**Analysis \& Market Intelligence** 



* Contribute to market and competitive intelligence efforts by monitoring industry trends, competitor capabilities, and changing customer use cases.
* Analyze customer feedback, support data, and usage patterns to spot gaps, friction points, and opportunities.
* Assist the Sr. PMs in assessing feature ideas and prioritization decisions through thorough analysis and documentation.



  





 Whom We’re Looking For
 


 We hire for four traits above all else. The rest is downstream of these.
 



* **Clarity in communication:** 

 You can take a complex problem and explain it to engineering, sales, and senior stakeholders in a way that each of them can act on. Your documentation is brief, precise, and clear.
* **Confident and coachable:** 

 You’re comfortable saying “I don’t know” and “I was wrong.” You stand your ground when you have evidence and update your view when the evidence suggests otherwise.
* **Applied thinking:** 

 You analyze user problems thoroughly before jumping to solutions. You work backward from what the user is trying to achieve and notice the secondary questions others overlook.
* **Fast learner:** 

 You quickly acquire new skills, explore unfamiliar areas, respond to feedback, and figure things out. You don’t wait for instructions on what to do next.



  





 Qualification \& Requirements
 
* 1–3 years of experience in a product, business analysis, consulting, or a related role in a B2B or SaaS environment.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem\-solving skills — you can break down ambiguous problems and clarify them.
* Excellent written communication — your documentation is clear, precise, and easy to understand without a meeting to explain it.
* Proven ability to synthesize inputs from various sources into coherent, actionable documentation.
* Comfort working closely with engineering teams — you don’t need to write code, but you should understand how software systems function.
* Attention to detail without losing sight of the bigger picture. A genuine curiosity about how products work and how users actually experience them.



  





 Tools \& Technical Skills
 
* Familiar with product and project management tools like Jira, Confluence, Notion, or similar.
* Comfortable working with data — able to read reports, interpret usage metrics, and identify key insights.
* Experience creating user stories, PRDs, or functional specs is a plus. Exposure to AI or SaaS products is beneficial but not required.
* Basic understanding of APIs or data flows is useful; you don’t need to be technical, but you should have a curiosity about technology.



  





 Our Culture and Values
 


 At Contify, we are a people\-first organization where emotional intelligence is as critical as strategic expertise. We are looking for a collaborative leader who thrives in a team\-centric environment and is deeply committed to our collective mission of delivering exceptional user value.
 





 You prioritize the team’s success and actively support your colleagues in achieving shared milestones. Beyond individual performance, you have a natural drive to elevate those around you, fostering a culture of continuous improvement, mentorship, and mutual growth.

When you join Verizon
   

  

 You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing...**
 At Verizon, we aren't just building a world\-class Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) organization, we are fundamentally redefining the future of finance. As we step into the AI era, we are pioneering intelligent, AI\-driven FP\&A practices that will completely transform how finance teams operate and deliver strategic value. Through a comprehensive initiative to streamline processes, modernize our systems, and invest heavily in the continuous growth of our people, we are setting the industry standard. This is your opportunity to be a driver of this AI\-powered revolution, making Verizon the ultimate destination for forward\-thinking FP\&A professionals.
   

  

 Move Beyond Compiling Data And Help Tell The Story Behind The Numbers. The Corporate FP\&A Positions Offer Opportunities To Drive Better Business Partnering And Insights While Developing Your Skill Set And Career As We Continue To Grow As a World\-class Organization. You Are a Valuable Business Partner, Finding New And Better Ways Of Working By Leveraging Digital And AI Capabilities. You’ll Become Involved In Planning, Reporting, Analyses, And Initiatives That Will Impact Important Decisions Around The Growth And Development Of Verizon's Business. In Our Department, You Will
   

  

* Build and Maintain Intelligent Workflows: Identify bottlenecks in traditional FP\&A processes (like month\-end close or manual data consolidation) and support the implementation of automations and AI solutions.
* AI\-Enhanced Data Storytelling: Transform complex, multi\-layered datasets into clear, actionable intelligence using data visualization tools and AI\-generated insights.
* Connect Finance and Technology: Help bridge the gap between traditional FP\&A and data science teams, assisting in data preparation so AI algorithms are trained with deep financial context.
* Prompt Engineering for Finance: Utilize generative AI tools to rapidly synthesize financial data, draft preliminary variance narratives, and accelerate the reporting cycle.
* Ensure timely and accurate delivery of financial planning, reporting \& analyses for the business.
* Support Decision\-Making: Provide reliable data support and analytical guidance to FP\&A Business Partners.
* Data\-Driven Value Creation: Move beyond retrospective reporting to assist in forward\-looking planning, utilizing AI\-driven scenario models to support executive decision\-making.
* Actively participate in the cultural and professional development of Corporate FP\&A as a world\-class organization through Mentor/Mentee relationships and various activities offered.
* Embrace Change: Adopt and champion AI and modern finance practices within your daily workflows, helping the broader Verizon team see the proven results of automation.


 As part of the Corporate FP\&A team, you will be helping the reporting and accounting teams deliver world\-class, zero\-touch automated solutions for all Verizon entities. You will interact with finance teams across the business, helping bring new automated and AI\-driven solutions to life for our month\-end financial close and reporting activities.
   

  

**Reporting, Automation \& Data Visualization**
* Develop end\-to\-end automated solutions for our stakeholders to support Finance Business Units (BUs) and drive efficiencies.
* Build and design data visualizations of financial statements for different organizations across Verizon.
* Assist in preparation of C\-Suite Executive reporting with 100% quality and accuracy.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to maintain Qlik/ Looker Applications in production environments and resolve any production issues with existing applications.
* Document processes to ensure accuracy across the enterprise and maintain strict change control.


**AI \& Analytics Systems Development**
* Develop and test AI solutions that interact with development tools, codebases, and team workflows.
* Work with LLM APIs (Claude, Gemini, Codex, and others) to understand their capabilities, limitations, and practical application for financial automation.
* Support the end\-user experience of agentic interactions—ensuring complex AI capabilities feel natural and trustworthy for finance teams.
* Contribute to technical discussions regarding agent patterns, model selection, and integration approaches.


**What We’re Looking For…**
 You are a strong collaborator who can effectively manage and prioritize multiple tasks and adapt during pressured situations. You display initiative and resourcefulness but are also comfortable brainstorming and sharing ideas in a team environment. You possess excellent communication skills and can partner effectively across multiple business and finance teams. You are adaptable to change, meet tight deadlines, and are strongly focused on the quality of your deliverables.
   

  

**You'll Need To Have**
* Bachelor’s degree and one or more years of work experience in financial report automations, business intelligence, or data analytics.
* Hands\-on experience or strong academic exposure to building/utilizing AI tools, prompts, or workflows.
* Understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations across multiple models (Claude, Gemini, Codex, etc.).
* Familiarity with prompt engineering and working with tool\-use/function calling.
* Ability to mine, extract, transform, and load large financial datasets to create automated reports.
* Working knowledge of report automation tools, technologies, and end\-to\-end ETL processes (e.g., Knime Analytics Platform, Alteryx).
* Experience with Qlik Sense, Looker, or similar visualization tools.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and database queries.
* Knowledge of Google Suite and ticketing tools (e.g., Jira).


**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**
* Familiarity with Python or Google App Scripting for modern data and AI workflows.
* Experience with Essbase and SQL performance tuning.
* Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for agentic systems.
* Vizlib and NPrinting experience in Qlik Sense.
* Exposure to GCP Big Query or Teradata databases.
* A proven ability to derive insights from data and recommend actionable business strategies.

 In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.

description:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Business Content Writer who can create engaging business content for our international clients. The ideal candidate should have excellent writing skills, strong research abilities, and the confidence to communicate with clients to understand their requirements and transform them into informative blogs, articles, website content, and marketing materials. The role also involves communicating with international clients to gather inputs, understand requirements, and create well\-researched blogs, articles, and business content tailored to their needs.
   

  

**Responsibilities \& Duties**
* Write high\-quality, unique, and engaging articles and business content for websites, blogs, case studies, email campaigns, brochures, and marketing materials.
* Communicate with international clients to gather inputs, understand business requirements, and develop SEO\-friendly articles based on client discussions, industry trends, and market research.
* Proofread and edit content to ensure clarity, accuracy, consistency, and brand tone.
* Create titles, descriptions, captions, and promotional content for YouTube videos to improve their engagement and visibility.
* Work with the social media team to support marketing campaigns and improve online engagement.
* Connect with international publishers and publish articles.
* Should be responsible for publishing articles in journals and in magazines about the brand we deliver.
* Conduct research on industry trends, market insights, competitors, and target audiences to produce relevant content.
* Maintain content calendars and deliver assignments within deadlines.


**Key Skills \& Requirements**
* A Bachelor's degree in English, Journalism, Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Prior experience in business content writing, copywriting, technical writing, publishing articles in magazines/journals/newspapers, or content marketing is preferred.
* Ability to interact professionally with international clients and gather content requirements.
* Strong research and analytical skills.
* Working knowledge of SEO, GEO, and AEO keyword research and content optimization techniques.
* Familiarity with content management systems (CMS) and digital publishing platforms.
* Ability to simplify complex business concepts into clear and engaging content.
* Strong attention to detail, creativity, and proofreading skills.
* Excellent time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects.
* A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.


**Benefits**
* Yearly Bonus \& Increment
* Complimentary Lunch thrice a week \& Breakfast on Saturdays
* SBI Health Insurance Policy Coverage
* Sick days off
* ESI \& EPF benefits
* Commuting support
* Team building activities

title: Business Advisory Analyst
description:
**Skill required:** 
 Talent \& HR \- Employee Data Process Design
   

  

**Designation:** 
 Business Advisory Analyst
   

  

**Qualifications:** 
 Any Graduation
   

  

**Years of Experience:** 
 3 to 5 years
   

  

**About Accenture**
 Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
   

  

**What would you do?** 
 Improve workforce performance and productivity, boosts business agility, increases revenue and reduces costs Talent \& HR Process involves managing the recruitment, development, and retention of employees. This includes overseeing hiring, onboarding, training, and performance evaluations. The goal is to ensure a skilled and motivated workforce. Responsibilities also include developing HR policies, handling employee relations, and ensuring compliance with labor laws. This role is essential for building a strong and effective team. The design of employee data processes to manage employment data, records and transactions using standard technologies and processes.
   

  

**What are we looking for?** 
 "Join our dynamic HR Solutions team as a Tier 1 Workday Transaction Analyst! You’ll be the first point of contact for Workday\-related HR transactions, ensuring smooth, accurate, and timely processing for our employees. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, love solving problems, and have a knack for detail, this is the role for you.
   

  

* Serve as the primary responder for employee queries and requests related to Workday hire to retire transactions (hires, terminations, data changes, etc.).
* Process high\-volume, Hire to Retire HR transactions in Workday with accuracy and within defined SLAs.
* Conduct regular data audits to ensure data integrity and compliance.
* Troubleshoot and resolve basic Workday issues, escalating complex cases as needed.
* Collaborate with HR Business Partners and other stakeholders to deliver seamless HR services.
* Ensure compliance with employment laws, company policies, and data privacy requirements.
* Identify process gaps and suggest improvements for greater efficiency.
* Maintain clear documentation of processes and resolutions.
* Support rotational shifts, including US hours, as required.
* Assist in data validation, reporting, and system audits.
* Excellent communication skills—able to build trust and interact with stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-changing environment.
* Eagerness to learn new systems and adapt to evolving processes.
* A team player is mindset with a sense of urgency and ownership. Consistently produces work of exceptional quality, with meticulous attention to process and outcomes. Roles and Responsibilities:
* In this role you are required to do analysis and solving of lower\-complexity problems
* Your day to day interaction is with peers within Accenture before updating supervisors
* In this role you may have limited exposure with clients and/or Accenture management
* You will be given moderate level instruction on daily work tasks and detailed instructions on new assignments
* The decisions you make impact your own work and may impact the work of others
* You will be an individual contributor as a part of a team, with a focused scope of work
* Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts

title: Profile Business Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst with deep hands\-on experience on the FIS Profile core banking platform to bridge business stakeholders and technology delivery teams. The ideal candidate combines strong functional knowledge of retail and commercial banking operations with practical Profile configuration and integration expertise and can translate complex business needs into clear implementable requirements across core banking deposits lending payments and regulatory domains.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Lead requirements elicitation analysis and documentation for initiatives on the FIS Profile core banking platform producing BRDs FRDs user stories and acceptance criteria.
   

  

 Configure and validate Profile parameters across deposit and lending products working with technical teams on Profiles account transaction and product setup structures.
   

  

 Analyze and document business processes for Core Banking Deposits and Certificates of Deposit (CDs) including interest calculation accruals maturity and statement cycles.
   

  

 Define functional requirements for Loans and Loan Syndication covering origination servicing participant accounting and repayment schedules.
   

  

 Support Cards (Credit/Debit) workflows and their integration with the core including authorization posting and reconciliation flows.
   

  

 Map ACH and payment\-framework requirements including file formats settlement returns and exception handling and their interfaces to Profile.
   

  

 Translate US Tax requirements ( 1099/1098 reporting withholding backup withholding) into system rules and reporting specifications.
   

  

 Ensure solutions comply with applicable Financial Regulations partnering with compliance and risk teams on controls and audit requirements.
   

  

 Facilitate workshops lead UAT triage defects and serve as the functional liaison between business development and QA throughout the delivery lifecycle.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 The Tax \& Legal Technology team develops and maintains products built on varied technologies. The team has various groups that provide solutions to clients by following an agile system development methodology. This position is specifically for the Tax \& Legal Digital Asset Factory team.
   

  

 If you are a technology enthusiast and looking forward to working on the latest and in\-demand technology stack and want to make an impact on digital transformation, then this role is for you.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Software Engineer II on the Tax and Legal Digital Asset Factory team, you will be responsible for:
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using Angular
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to transform design concepts into functional prototypes and production\-ready interfaces, and contribute to design systems for consistency and reusability
* Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code while optimizing applications for speed, scalability, performance, and responsiveness
* Collaborate with back\-end developers to integrate application programming interfaces (APIs), troubleshoot issues, and enhance overall user experience
* Conduct code reviews, share knowledge with team members, and stay current on emerging technologies and industry trends to improve the technology stack


**The team**
 Do you want DIGITAL challenges and FUN? Do you want to make an IMPACT in digital transformation? Join the Tax and Legal Digital Asset Factory!
   

  

 The vision of the Digital Asset Factory is to accelerate our Tax \& Legal market leadership by delivering unparalleled value through AI\-powered innovation. Navigating our regulated business and robust guardrails, we are positioned as responsible innovation leaders. The team supports this vision by leveraging latest technology and artificial intelligence to create innovative solutions that differentiate from competition through increased efficiency, quality, and an end\-to\-end globally consistent digital experience.
   

  

 All team members are expected to proactively apply artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies in their daily work to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and productivity. This includes leveraging AI\-powered solutions such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot4DevOps, and other relevant platforms to prepare and accelerate deliverables, rather than solely relying on manual creation followed by AI validation. A mindset of continuous AI adoption and innovation is essential to drive smarter workflows and faster outcomes. Additionally, team members will contribute actively to the AI enablement initiatives within the technology function, supporting the integration, optimization, and scaling of AI capabilities across projects and processes.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 11 AM to 8 PM
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Engineering
* 3\+ years of front\-end development experience with Angular
* Experience with design systems, including creation, maintenance, and implementation
* Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and frameworks such as Bootstrap or Material Design
* Experience with state management libraries such as NgRx or Redux and RESTful application programming interfaces (APIs)
* Experience integrating third\-party libraries into Angular projects, including PrimeNG and Kendo UI for Angular
* Experience applying Angular security practices, including JSON Web Token (JWT) authentication and secure data transmission


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience with responsive design and cross\-browser compatibility
* Experience applying accessibility standards and best practices
* Experience using Git
* Experience with secure software development life cycle practices
* Experience working in Agile Scrum environments
* Fluency in English

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Meet The Team**
 The AutoQuote team at Cisco builds and operates the automated quoting platform that powers Cisco's global renewals business. Our mission is to generate accurate, ready\-to\-order quotes at scale — minimizing manual effort for partners and distributors, reducing booking friction, and driving simplification across Cisco's renewal workflows.
   

  

 We are a product engineering team running a homegrown, cloud\-native application hosted on GCP. Our stack is built on a microservices architecture orchestrated with Kubernetes, with Prefect managing our data and workflow pipelines, and Pub/Sub and REST APIs handling communication across services. We move fast, operate at scale, and are actively integrating AI capabilities into the core of what we build.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep AI fluency to join the AutoQuote team at Cisco. This role is central to driving the architecture, development, and delivery of AI\-powered software features within the AutoQuote application. The ideal candidate brings a strong engineering foundation, hands\-on experience integrating and using AI tools within production software, and the ability to guide technical initiatives while mentoring the engineers around them.
   

  

 AI fluency is a core requirement of this role — not just familiarity, but the demonstrated ability to use LLMs, AI coding assistants, and prompt engineering techniques as everyday development tools to accelerate velocity and improve output quality.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead the design, development, and integration of AI\-powered features, agentic workflows, and automation into the AutoQuote application — using available AI services and tools rather than building models from scratch.
* Architect scalable, cloud\-native solutions on GCP and AWS, selecting the best language and tools for performance and maintainability — Python proficiency is expected, but technology choices should be driven by what is right for the problem.
* Actively use AI coding assistants, LLMs (e.g., Claude, Gemini, GPT), and prompt engineering techniques to accelerate development, debug complex problems, and produce higher\-quality code faster.
* Drive responsible AI practices across the team, including evaluating AI tool outputs, prompt governance, and ethical AI considerations.
* Collaborate with product management, data science, and QA to translate requirements into robust, well\-tested technical implementations.
* Define and enforce software engineering standards within a CI/CD environment, ensuring maintainable, testable, and reliable code.
* Lead code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical planning sessions.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers on AI development, cloud\-native patterns, and disciplined engineering practices.
* Stay ahead of emerging AI frameworks, LLM capabilities, and agentic design patterns to continuously improve on what the team delivers.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a demonstrated track record of staying ahead of the AI curve — actively adopting and applying AI tools, workflows, and capabilities as they have evolved.
* Proficiency in Python; ability to architect solutions using the best possible languages for performance — technology selection should match the problem, not default to a single stack.
* Hands\-on experience applying AI/ML frameworks and services (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain, or cloud\-managed AI services) to real engineering problems.
* Hands\-on experience with GCP and/or AWS, including managed AI/ML and cloud infrastructure services.
* Demonstrated ability to write effective prompts and use LLMs to accelerate development, automate workflows, and solve engineering problems.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, agile methodologies, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with automated testing, deployment planning, and operating production software systems.
* Strong communication, leadership, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with agentic AI systems, multi\-agent orchestration frameworks, or LLM\-based automation workflows.
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Cloud or AI certifications (GCP Professional, AWS, or equivalent).
* Prior experience in a DevOps or NetDevOps environment with AI integration.


**Additional Information**
* This role requires an engineer who can both contribute directly to complex features and elevate the technical capabilities of the team around them.
* Strong AI literacy — including the ability to design prompts, critically evaluate model outputs, and integrate AI tooling into engineering workflows — is a non\-negotiable expectation.
* The candidate will be expected to model disciplined engineering practices while embracing AI\-assisted development as a force multiplier for the entire team.
* All work is conducted in adherence to Cisco security policy and compliance requirements, including responsible handling of data and AI\-generated content.


 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Software Dev Engineer, Amazon Pay
description:
**Description**
 AmazonPay, one of the fastest growing businesses of Amazon, enables e\-commerce websites to accept, and customers to utilise the payment information stored in their Amazon.com accounts to pay for goods and services at sites off\-Amazon. AmazonPay also enables customers to manage their account preferences and see their off\-Amazon transactions.
   

  

 Hundreds of thousands of Users make millions of transactions worldwide on AmazonPay. The engineers within our team are instrumental in allowing us drive the stability and sustainability of our next\-generation software and to discover innovative ways to automate and scale our software as we expand globally. We develop and support software at every level of the stack from front\-end user interfaces to backend server software and everything in between.
   

  

 SDEs work hand\-in\-hand with Software Development teams and Business teams to automate and invent new ways of enhancing buyer and merchant experience of AmazonPay.
   

  

 We’re looking for technology leaders for one of fastest growing verticals of Amazon. This position is perfect for you if you’re interested in creating tools and automation so that engineers can be as hands\-off as possible. We want our service to be as autonomous as possible and that can only be done by having bright individuals who understand how to think big, simplify solutions to complex, never before seen problems; all while ensuring that the customer continues to have the best experience possible. We are not looking for engineers that are interested in performing operational work all day but instead engineers who thrive on creating automation to reduce the operational workload. A love for operational excellence, working with new technologies and pushing the envelope on existing technology is required.
   

  

 This is an excellent opportunity to join Amazon’s world\-class technical teams, working with some of the best and brightest engineers while also developing your skills and furthering your career within one of the most dynamic, innovative and progressive technology companies anywhere. description:
**Overview**
 Microsoft is a company where passionate innovators come to collaborate, envision what can be and take their careers further. This is a world of more possibilities, more innovation, more openness, and the sky is the limit thinking in a cloud\-enabled world.
   

  

 Microsoft’s Azure Data engineering team is leading the transformation of analytics in the world of data with products like databases, data integration, big data analytics, messaging \& real\-time analytics, and business intelligence. title: Frontend Developer
description:
Frontend Developer
 



**Company:** 
 Deccan AI
 **Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 **Experience:** 
 4\-6 years
 



  





 About the Role
 



 Deccan AI is a venture\-backed AI infrastructure company ($25M Series A, Prosus Ventures), headquartered in the Bay Area with an engineering hub in Hyderabad. We build the infrastructure layer for Reinforcement Learning and Agentic AI and work with frontier labs including Google DeepMind and Snowflake.
 



  





 Deccan AI is looking for a Frontend Developer to design and build the tools our human annotators and reviewers use every day, including data labeling interfaces, QA dashboards, and annotation workflows that power our AI training pipelines. You'll work at the intersection of great UX and complex data structures, building tools that need to be fast, intuitive, and reliable at scale.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 


* Design and build web\-based data labeling and annotation tools (text, image, audio, video, and multimodal annotation interfaces)
* Build intuitive UIs for complex workflows: bounding boxes, segmentation, entity tagging, conversation rating, ranking/comparison interfaces, etc.
* Collaborate closely with product, ML, and operations teams to translate labeling guidelines into usable tool features
* Optimize for annotator speed and accuracy, since every extra click or lag point affects throughput at scale
* Build real\-time collaboration features, keyboard\-shortcut\-driven workflows, and progress/QA dashboards
* Ensure tools perform well with large datasets (virtualization, lazy loading, efficient state management)
* Write clean, maintainable, well\-tested code and participate in code reviews
* Iterate quickly based on annotator feedback and changing labeling requirements



  





 What We're Looking For
 


* Strong proficiency in React (or similar modern frontend framework) and JavaScript/TypeScript
* Experience building data\-dense or workflow\-heavy UIs (dashboards, editors, internal tools)
* Solid understanding of state management (Redux, Zustand, React Query, etc.)
* Experience with canvas/SVG\-based interactions (for image/video annotation tools) is a strong plus
* Familiarity with performance optimization for large lists/datasets (virtualization libraries, memoization)
* Understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs and integrating with backend services
* Good eye for UX; you care about reducing friction for end users, not just shipping features
* Experience with component libraries and design systems
* Bonus: experience with WebSockets/real\-time features, accessibility (a11y), or prior work on annotation/labeling tools specifically



  





 Nice to Have
 


* Experience in AI/ML data pipelines or working with data labeling vendors/platforms
* Familiarity with audio/video processing in\-browser
* Experience with testing frameworks (Jest, Playwright/Cypress)



  





 Why Join Deccan AI
 


* Work directly on tools that shape the quality of AI training data at scale
* High ownership role, you'll influence tool architecture and UX decisions from early on
* Fast\-paced, collaborative environment working closely with ML and ops teams

Position: HR Executive – Restaurant \& Café

Company: Pentoz Hotels Private Limited

Business Unit: Pentoz Restaurant \& Café

Reports To: General Manager / Managing Director

Employment Type: Full\-Time
